exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Conditionals — if you… we could…

items.prompt: If you ___ to a longer contract, we can improve the price.
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'if', não se usa 'will': o verbo fica no presente.

items.prompt: We would be able to match that if you ___ the volume.
items.hintAfterError: Com 'would' na outra parte, o verbo depois de 'if' vai para o passado.

items.prompt: If you can confirm by Friday, we ___ lock in the rate.
We could include reports, ___ you sign annually.
If you ___ the order, we would waive the fee.
